items.information: **Willkommen zur zweiten BLD-Competition in Fürth!** Die Runden 1+2 werden als Dual Round stattfinden. Alle Runden werden in zwei Gruppen stattfinden. Du wirst in einer Gruppe teilnehmen und in der anderen Gruppe entweder als Runner, Judge oder Scrambler mithelfen. Bitte beachtet: Die Venue ist neben einer Kirche mit Glocken. Wenn ihr Empfindlich bei Störungen seid, achtet bitte auf Gehörschutz. **Welcome to the second BLD-Competition in Fürth!** All rounds 1+2 will take place as dual rounds. All rounds will be run in two groups. You will compete in one group and help out in the other group as a runner, judge, or scrambler. Please note: The venue is located next to a church with bells. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAwNjE4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b43ed93d443e818ec3d1a884cc2d98984257c3d3/Your%20paragraph%20text%20(2)%20-%20Copia.png) Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Ao se inscrever você se compromete a ajudar como juiz, corredor ou qualquer função solicitada por um delegado da competição; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - By registering, you agree to assist as a judge, runner, or in any other role requested by a delegate; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NjcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d276ee4a1432869c38d809b8802b47006f609e10/Megamente_2026.png) # Español Hay desafíos que no se vencen solo con velocidad; se dominan con la capacidad de visualizar lo que otros no pueden. **Megaminx** es una prueba de estrategia, creatividad y control bajo presión. Es el eje de esta competencia. Pero **Mega-Mente** es mucho más que un solo rompecabezas. Cada categoría ha sido seleccionada para ponerte a prueba. **¿Tienes lo necesario para adaptarte a cualquier desafío?** Porque no importa qué tan rápido gires un cubo. Lo que importa es... **qué tan lejos puedas llevar tu mente.** #### **¡BIENVENIDOS A MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que **todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)**. ​ **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ # English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Some challenges can't be conquered by speed alone; they are mastered through the ability to visualize what others cannot. **Megaminx** is a test of strategy, creativity, and composure under pressure. It is the centerpiece of this competition. But **Mega-Mente** is much more than a single puzzle. Every event has been carefully chosen to challenge you. **Do you have what it takes to adapt to every challenge?** Because it doesn't matter how fast you can turn a cube. What matters is... **how far you can push your mind.** #### **WELCOME TO MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 is an official WCA competition, so **all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations)**. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: UC Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. This competition will utilize dual rounds, meaning that all competitors will advance to the second round of each event, and the winner/ranking of each event will be determined by the best result of each competitor across the two rounds. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JPIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--09f328966024b349b182c10e5943a3983f83b9cd/snz_logo_v06.png) [Website](https://speedcubing.nz) | [Facebook](https://facebook.com/speedcubingnz) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/speedcubingnz)
